question: Who has been selected as the new World Bank President in May 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajay Banga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **World Bank **

 
 
• It was established in 1944 with the primary goal of providing financial and technical assistance for the reconstruction of Europe after World War II.
 
• Over time, its mission has expanded to include aiding the development of member countries by providing loans, credits, and grants for a wide array of purposes that include infrastructure, education, health, and environmental projects, among others.
 
• The IBRD raises most of its funds on the world's financial markets by selling World Bank bonds to investors.
 
• With the capital raised, it offers financial products and policy advice to its member countries with the aim of reducing poverty and supporting sustainable economic development.
 
• The IBRD is notable for its focus on development projects that can improve the economic prospects and quality of life for people in developing countries, while also emphasizing the importance of good governance, anti-corruption measures, and environmental sustainability.
